title: THE MAGNET STOPS AT A SHUT STRONGHOLD FENCE
why: The MAGNET pulls loose wrecks and caches toward you from about fifty metres, and its own rule is that a wreck never slides through a wall or out of a shut room. A stronghold fence is a wall nobody crosses, but the magnet did not know it: standing outside a stronghold with a MAGNET running pulled the STRONGHOLD CACHE out through a fence whose gate was never breached, to the player's feet, where he searched it without the breach or the fight. Proven in headless Chromium: the stronghold cache looted with the gate still shut (cache 342 from the centre of a 240 ring). A box now stops at a stronghold fence that is still shut; once the gate is breached the magnet pulls it as before.
now: The magnet no longer pulls a stronghold cache out through a shut fence.
